technology-label: Ammonia plant with capture on the process CO2
description: The CO2 removal step ahead of synthesis already delivers a pure stream; capture is dehydration and compression, and part of it is already sold for urea.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. This is the cheapest capture in the sector and should not be averaged with flue-gas capture. Full capture needs a second, dilute plant on the reformer flue gas. TRL basis: iea_2024_001 row 347 (partial capture); row 346 gives 6 for full capture.

technology-label: Steam methane reformer with capture on the shift gas
description: Capture on the shifted syngas, where the CO2 is already at high partial pressure. Taking the reformer flue gas as well needs a second, dilute-stream plant.
note: Concentrated stream, held once on cross-sector co2-capture-concentrated. Partial capture takes only the shift gas and reaches about 60% of the plant total; full capture adds a diffuse-stream plant on the reformer flue gas. TRL basis: iea_2024_001 row 285 (partial capture); row 284 gives 6 for high capture rates.
